summary: Show always-visible labels on graph nodes
description: Each 3D node shows its name as a SpriteText label, not only on hover. Load three-spritetext from unpkg.
scope: Add script src https://unpkg.com/three-spritetext in index.html before viewer.js
viewer.js calls new SpriteText, nodeThreeObject, and nodeThreeObjectExtend(true)
acceptanceCriteria: index.html includes three-spritetext. viewer.js contains SpriteText, nodeThreeObject, and nodeThreeObjectExtend.
constraints: Strict TDD: write the failing test first and run it before implementation.
Do not add a watcher or CLI unless this task explicitly requires it.
Do not add npm or a bundler.
Do not remove the hover nodeLabel.

subtasks.title: SpriteText labels on every node

instructions: Write the failing test in tests/test_node_labels.py first.

Run python -m pytest tests/test_node_labels.py -q and stop when it passes.
